verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents its own 'unlimited cloud storage for all your business documents' within its registered-agent offering, and a 24/7 personalized dashboard, so executed contracts could be stored there. Nothing in the evidence shows a searchable contract repository or any extraction of key terms and metadata. missing for 10: search over stored contracts, AI or automated key-term/metadata extraction, contract-specific repository features (fields, tagging, renewal or obligation tracking), independent or hands-on corroboration.
